prompt: You join a new club and struggle to remember people's names. Which strategy is most likely to help?

options.text: Avoid using anyone's name until you are sure you know them all
Speak to only one person each week, to keep it manageable
Link each name to a vivid image or rhyme when you first hear it, and use the name in conversation
Write all the names down once and never look at the list again

explanation: A vivid link gives your memory something distinctive to hold on to, and actually using the name straight away turns a first hearing into a first practice.
